title: Claude Feature 08: Chat private rakhne ke 2 tareeke #shorts
description:
Claude Feature 08 (Claude for Everyone): privacy ke do settings. Pehla: Settings, phir Privacy me "Help Improve our AI models" toggle off karne se aapki nayi chats aage ki model training me use nahi hongi. Dhyan rakhiye: jo data pehle hi training me ja chuka hai, wo wapas nahi hota. Ye setting Free, Pro aur Max plans ke liye hai. Doosra: incognito chat. Upar daayein kone me ghost icon dabaiye; chat history aur memory me save nahi hoti aur training me use nahi hoti. Band karne ke baad ye chat dobara nahi khulti, isliye zaroori baat pehle copy kar lijiye. Incognito Projects ke andar available nahi hai. Safety ke liye incognito chats default me 30 din tak rakhi jaati hain.

Sources (official):
https://privacy.claude.com/en/articles/12109829-how-do-i-change-my-model-improvement-privacy-settings
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12260368-use-incognito-chats

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the page crops are our own capture of the official pages (key lines highlighted). The toggle and ghost drawings are illustrations. Synthetic voice.
